title: Recurring Evidence that Everything is a Metaphor

meta.author: Pat Szot
meta.description: Voluptates cum minima qui accusamus quia nisi blanditiis et. Do

content:
The shit we call out life's work will eventually just be a metaphor.

I think about this often— how everything is a metaphor for everything else. Not that that is a bad thing at all.Theres a visual in my mind comparing how we used to gather around a campfire (a source of light) to tell stories and now its hours in front of a screen (another source of light). The purpose itself doesn't change, just the way we do so.Everything is a metaphor for the way things used to be. Which leads me to believe that the most important gift one generation can give the next are metaphors to help them understand the world. (Imperfectly) copy-paste on, future humans.
